runtime.scope: Source review only. No Nextcloud installation, command invocation, data clearing or upstream instructions executed.

findings: README combines event-driven updates, periodic background reconciliation and explicit scan. Its prose says5days while its configuration table find interval172800seconds is2days; actual ConfigService not yet reviewed.
Background job delegates each user to scanFiles without local per-user exception handling; scanner behavior beyond FileInfoService boundary remains unread. No whole-instance resilience guarantee.

Missing requested relative path returns void early with verbosity-verbose notice. FindDuplicates command initializes result0 and does not receive completion/error status from scanFiles; source path can report success without scanning requested scope. No native Nextcloud reproduction yet.

Explicit-user NotFoundException catch logs and prints but does not set result1. Unknown user sets1 then breaks, leaving later users unvisited. Boolean path warning does not return; Symfony VALUE_IS_ARRAY normal parsing is not proven to admit that value.

save catches any Exception spanning lookup, update and event dispatch, then attempts new insertion. Thus a dispatch/update failure can be interpreted as missing record; no transactional recovery or actual DB failure reproduction established.

Hash recalculation uses cached emptyhash/strictly newer mtime or uploadtime, with mounted node OR outside the filetype conjunction. SHA256 is requested from storage; no bytewise equality confirmation or before/after identity validation in this reviewed service method. Storage/event/mapper semantics remain incomplete.
Clear command clears duplicate records then file info sequentially; no transaction shown in command. Its help explicitly concerns database records rather than filesystem contents. Not executed.
Four controller tests use mocked services and assert response success/failure for logged-in/out/anonymous/error. Do not establish actual scan, storage, pagination or access filtering behavior.
Screening license metadata AGPL-3.0 differs from composer GPL-3.0-only. Root COPYING has not been whole-read in this pass; no license compatibility conclusion or upstream implementation adoption.
findAll loops full mapper pages after filtering, carrying entity id as next offset; mapper ordering/cursor contract not yet reviewed, so no pagination correctness or bug claim.
